Xi Jinping to Meet Trump Amidst Trade and Tech Tensions

Chinese President Xi Jinping was set to arrive in Washington for a high-stakes summit with U.S. President Donald Trump. Ahead of the summit, Xi Jinping reportedly dropped 'red lines' that had previously been a sticking point.
